messages:
Maya P: heads-up — Nimbus Labs asked for a joint 25m talk + 15m live demo at CloudActor Summit (June). They're pushing an on-device quantization story, want an inference cost slide and a short hack demo. can we scope? :thinking:
Owen L: sounds good. who from our side can present? we should avoid product-heavy slides. maybe devex + solutions.
Sarah K: i can do the product intro (5m). Devon can own the demo. @Devon (Solutions) can you confirm infra needs?
Devon (Solutions): yep. demo needs 2x A10G or 1x A40 + access to private model build. prefer pre-recorded fallback + live Q/A. bandwidth for model artifacts — we can host on S3.
Maya P: budget for swag and shipping? Nimbus will cover local handouts but we should send stickers + 100 stickers + 25 demo-branded mints. estimated cost $250.
Owen L: ok. can marketing approve sticker art by May 10? cc @Sarah K for creative.
Sarah K: will route design to marketing. ETA May 3 for first pass.
Devon (Solutions): run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-05:00 - Opening + why partnership
05:00-10:00 - Product overview (Sarah)
10:00-25:00 - Live demo (Devon)
25:00-35:00 - Q&A
35:00-40:00 - Closing / CTAs
```
Maya P: love it. need risk plan: if live demo fails -> fallback to pre-recorded 7-min clip + host-led commentary.
Owen L: can we add a short effort to bake in metrics slide: latency/cost-per-token vs naive baseline? ask research for numbers.
Devon (Solutions): i'll request perf numbers from infra team by Apr 28.
ops-bot: Reminder: please add the session to the events calendar and request AV kit 6 weeks before event. https://events.redwood.ai/schedule
Maya P: final asks: speaker bios (short), demo access creds (temp), and shipping address for swag dropoff. I'll compile and send to Nimbus.
Sarah K: i'll share bios by Apr 30.
Owen L: tagging legal — can we get a 1-paragraph approved partner blurb for marketing? @legal-team ?
Maya P: thanks everyone. i'll loop back with Nimbus after we have bios + perf numbers. :thumbsup:
